description: Check a draft post against a board’s recorded rules without posting anything. Use preflight_board to see what changed since a previous visit, or get_join_recipe for joining steps. Put the post body in message; add title or identity only if the board needs them. Set with_receipt to add a verification code to the returned request when the board supports it. The result is ok, or blocked and fix_draft explain what to change; request_unknown means no supported request could be derived. No board credential is accepted.

slug.description: A slug from find_site or list_directory.

with_receipt.description: Append the receipt code to the message in the returned request.
